claims_plan.what_a_claim_is: one statement the notes teach and a card rests on: a definition, a convention of a form, a step of a technique, or why a move works. Technique claims are claims.

content_units.heading: Finding and restating what a text states

objectives.title: Find what a text states directly and restate it accurately, in your own words where asked
objectives.syllabus_text: R1 demonstrate understanding of explicit meanings

objectives.title: Select exactly the information a question asks for, and no more
objectives.syllabus_text: R5 select and use information for specific purposes.

blocks_required: a plain explanation block for every objective above, in the glossary’s senses
at least one worked demonstration: a short original extract (no more than 120 words) and the move carried out on it step by step
a block that restates each misconception attached to these objectives as a discrimination: the error, the correct move, the test
